items.q: only recently had a guy come in and only do a couple, three, four weeks with me, a young man by the name of Gary Keller.

ctx.x: -- was one of the most exciting tenor players who's a throwback to bebop between this age and the time, and I think he has created a whole different kind of way to express himself. And he's an individual player. And I also -- only recently had a guy come in and only do a couple, three, four weeks with me, a young man by the name of Gary Keller.
